versions.changelog:
- Updated version to 1.0.1 in metadata.
- No functional or documentation changes.

Initial release of lygo-pxpipe-lygo:

- Introduces multi-tool vision context compression for LYGO-compatible LLMs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Grok/xAI, Gemini).
- Enables context shrinking by converting large text to PNGs for efficient LLM prompt/log usage.
- Provides both command-line and proxy operation modes with no auto-publish or git push.
- Requires lygo-protocol-stack and review of SECURITY.md; hardened via SkillSpector audit.
- User must avoid compressing secrets, API keys, or exact byte/line data.
